description: This file contains the 'MidiTools' class providing utility functions for Android MIDI device management, specifically a method to find a MIDI device matching specified manufacturer and product properties.

classes.name: MidiTools
classes.description: Utility class providing helper methods for MIDI device management on Android.

methods.name: findDevice
methods.description: Finds and returns a MIDI device info object that matches the specified manufacturer and product strings, or null if none match.
